scope: Git-anchor the spec-review receipt pool itself. Closes convergent batch-10/11/12 critique (~11 models) that the receipt pool is the trust-root weak point.

convergent_critique_addressed.reason: agent can forge receipt in .spec-review-receipts.jsonl because the pool is not git-anchored
convergent_critique_addressed.structural_answer: exec-verify.js now calls gitBlobFreshness() on the receipt pool. checks.receipt_pool_git_clean is added to the verification receipt. A modified-since-commit pool fails the verification, forcing any forged receipt to be committed, which at least provides git history as the audit trail.

provenance.remaining_known_limit: Local offline trust root is fundamentally limited — an adversary who controls the filesystem can commit forged receipts. Full closure requires remote notarization (signed commits, pushed origin) which is an out-of-scope escalation for this iter.
